# Repository Agent Resources

This repository provides AI coding agent resources under `.github/`. See the root `AGENTS.md` for the primary agent guide.

## Instructions

Task-specific `.instructions.md` files with `applyTo` patterns:

- `instructions/coding.instructions.md` — C# coding rules
- `instructions/csharp-summaries.instructions.md` — XML summary comment guidance
- `instructions/csharp-polymorphic-design.instructions.md` — polymorphic design over type-code conditionals
- `instructions/unit-and-integration-tests.instructions.md` — test authoring conventions
- `instructions/design.instructions.md` — `docs/DESIGN.md` guidance
- `instructions/development.instructions.md` — `docs/DEVELOPMENT.md` guidance
- `instructions/testing.instructions.md` — `docs/TESTING.md` guidance
- `instructions/operations.instructions.md` — `docs/OPERATIONS.md` guidance
- `instructions/readme.instructions.md` — `README.md` guidance
- `instructions/diagrams.instructions.md` — Mermaid diagram conventions
- `instructions/proposal-writing-guide.instructions.md` — proposal writing guidance
- `instructions/phase-plan.instructions.md` — multi-phase implementation plans
- `instructions/task-plan.instructions.md` — per-phase actionable task plans
- `instructions/github-workflow.instructions.md` — issue, branch, and commit workflow
- `instructions/conventional-commits.instructions.md` — commit message format
- `instructions/glossary.instructions.md` — `docs/GLOSSARY.md` guidance
- `instructions/writing-style.instructions.md` — concrete wording conventions

Domain-specific knowledge skills:
